chapterPurpose: ‘Energy — How Things Work’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects forms and sources of energy, everyday devices, energy transformations, fuel and electricity use, safety. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
